Description.Name: GN Drive Upgrade
Description.Details: The Argo refit with a GN drive allows for high sustained acceleration with no added weight for propulsion.This drive is a semi-perpetual device using the decay of exotic particles to provide the energy source for propulsion.

AssignedCastDescription: The Argo's GN Drive is far more powerful than I suspected. We may not ever bring it completely back online, but for now I can increase our thrust. While 2 g is not comfortable and the crew will complain, we'll cut our travel times significantly.
